dct_description_sm: North Oakville Zoning By-law 2009-189 is the comprehensive zoning by-law applying to all properties north of Dundas Street and south of Highway 407. It is the rule book controlling how land and buildings are used, the location of buildings on a lot, building heights, and other provisions necessary to ensure proper development. It was created as part of the planning process for North Oakville to implement the North Oakville Secondary Plans. Remaining lands in Oakville are covered by Zoning By-law 2014-014.
